# Recorded Azure batch synthesis responses

Hand-written from the documented shapes of the Azure AI Speech batch synthesis REST API (`api-version=2024-04-01`):
the job resource returned by `PUT` and `GET …/texttospeech/batchsyntheses/{id}`, an error body, and the files of the
result ZIP (`summary.json`, `NNNN.word.json`; the `NNNN.wav` files are generated by the tests). No key, endpoint or
real audio is recorded here. `tests/test_tts_azure.py` replays them; nothing in the test suite touches the network.
